description: Infra S.A., the Brazilian federal company for transport infrastructure planning, publishes its databases as open data through the National Transport and Logistics Observatory (ONTL) and a GeoPortal. The pages read on 2026-09-28 point to ONTL database queries downloadable as spreadsheets, CSV and JSON, a GIS viewer and a data transfer page where geographic layers can be searched by title and by transport mode: air, waterway, cabotage, pipeline, locks, rail, inland waterway and road. The observatory also offers analytical panels, a statistical yearbook, logistics diagnoses, road safety and road freight panoramas, and applications such as the national logistics plan 2035 viewer and an environmental information system for infrastructure in beta. Coverage is Brazil. Access is free download; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the query tool and layer list render partly by script, so individual tables and layer dates were not listed. It supports network flow and capacity studies of Brazilian freight corridors, such as loading rail, waterway and road networks with origin-destination flows. Related record: the ONTL transport cost simulator.
